title: Steer an explorer in Shiny — grafts-proxy
code: if (FALSE) { # interactive() library(shiny) tourism_agg <- fabletools::aggregate_key(   tsibble::tourism, Purpose * (State / Region), Trips = sum(Trips) ) ui <- fluidPage(   actionButton("nsw", "New South Wales"),   actionButton("recent", "Last 10 years"),   graftsOutput("ts") ) server <- function(input, output, session) {   output$ts <- renderGrafts(grafts(tourism_agg))   observeEvent(input$nsw, {     graftsProxy("ts") |> grafts_focus(list(State = "New South Wales"))   })   observeEvent(input$recent, {     recent <- tsibble::filter_index(tourism_agg, "2007 Q1" ~ .)     graftsProxy("ts") |> grafts_update(grafts(recent))   }) } shinyApp(ui, server) }
